description: The shape of nestedRefsNamedLikeDefinition, invoice.shipping referring to #/definitions/invoiceShipping, plus a second definition, invoice_shipping, that also maps to InvoiceShipping. The two are different types, so one of them is declared as InvoiceShipping_1 and other must refer to the one holding trackingNumber. Freeing the name when the placeholder was dropped let other bind to the wrong struct without a warning.
